reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the regulatory variant and gene follow-up use-case batch for use-case-regulatory-variant-gene-follow-up: 388 records after review (160 results, 136 evaluations, 44 configurations, 15 claims, 8 models, 8 protocols, 7 methods, 6 datasets, 4 sources). All four pinned artifacts were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256; archived copies decompress to the same bytes. All 160 results, including every bootstrap interval and standard error, were re-read with the reviewer's own parsers (the extractor's scripts were not run) and match. No number changed. Corrections, concern decisions, exclusions, judgement review and approved use-case changes are in docs/reviews/use-cases/regulatory-variant-gene-follow-up-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any model.
Figures, Manzo Supplementary Tables S1 and S2, Tang Additional file 1 and Gschwind Supplementary Table 1 were not checked.
The Europe PMC supplementaryFiles zip is rebuilt per request, so its container hash cannot be re-verified; the MOESM3 zip and the xlsx member were verified.

SHACL shapes and npm run build were not run; npm test and npm run typecheck passed, and an in-memory addBatch and deriveUseCaseInputs dry run passed with all eight new and all five existing judgements active.

Neural-network families recorded as kind method with -method- IDs; now kind model, entity_level family, consistent with existing model records. Configuration links updated.
Linked to catalog-model-dnabert-2 (an alias) and catalog-model-nt-v2 (version 50M); relinked to discovery-model-dnabert-2 and discovery-model-nucleotide-transformer.
version held a printed label such as 'Borzoi (as printed)'; now missing_metadata.version unreported with the label in the note. Tang HyenaDNA version set to hyenadna-tiny-1k-seqlen-d256 from Methods.
Descriptions stated facts not in the sources; now quote the sources.
Locator corrected to Results 2.1 paragraph 5; value extended with the Results 2.3 values and the HeLa ranking conflict. Two Manzo claims added (adaptation conflict, SNP counts).
